name: yamadori-harness-box
description: The three harnesses harness_box.py runs, at the exact versions of the host tests, plus their default loadout's tools: the Playwright MCP server (browser), typescript-language-server + typescript + pyright (language-server diagnostics: OpenCode's lsp, and tsc/pyright for the others), agent-browser (Pi's browser CLI). docs/HARNESS-SANDBOX.md, docs/HARNESSES.md. Official npm packages only; package-lock.json pins every tarball by sha512.
